name: 员工积分全量
description: 积分台账带员工当前部门与岗位
statement: SELECT p.id AS id, p.employee_no AS employee_no, p.employee_name AS employee_name, p.point_year AS point_year, p.point_type AS point_type, p.year_point AS year_point, p.total_point AS total_point, p.point_source AS point_source, p.relate_biz AS relate_biz, p.grant_date AS grant_date, p.honor_level AS honor_level, p.rank_no AS rank_no, p.point_status AS point_status, p.dept_avg_point AS dept_avg_point, p.dept_rank AS dept_rank, e.dept AS dept, e.position AS position, e.employee_status AS employee_status FROM hr_point p LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON e.employee_no = p.employee_no
